jobs.title: Software Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a driven and technically fluent Software Delivery Manager to lead software delivery teams on client engagements. Operating at Manager level, you will take day-to-day ownership of project delivery, team coordination, and client communication. You will work closely with Senior Delivery Managers, Architects, and engineering leads to ensure high-quality, iterative delivery of software solutions. The Software Delivery Manager operates within an overall programme context, with strategic and commercial accountability retained by the Senior Software Delivery Manager

Key Responsibilities

Owns day-to-day delivery execution within agreed programme constraints.
Lead day-to-day delivery of software projects and workstreams, ensuring adherence to scope, schedule, quality, and budget.
Manage cross-functional delivery teams of engineers, testers, and business analysts, fostering a high-performance and collaborative culture.
Plan and manage sprints, releases, and programme increments using Agile and Scrum practices.
Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for client project teams, building strong working relationships and trust.
Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate delivery risks and issues, escalating appropriately to Senior Delivery Managers and/or Programme Lead.
Prepare and present regular project status reports, dashboards, and governance packs to internal and client stakeholders.
Support commercial activities including change request management, time tracking, and budget monitoring.
Collaborate with Software Architects and technical leads to ensure solutions are delivered to agreed quality standards.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of delivery practices, tooling, and team processes.
Support the onboarding, coaching, and development of junior team members.
Ensure Agile principles and processes are applied appropriately across teams.
Translate technical risks, constraints, and issues into clear language for stakeholders.
Work with the Technical Lead and QA Lead to understand technical blockers, architectural considerations, and quality risks, ensuring these are represented in delivery planning.
Coordinate with Team Leads / Scrum Masters, Product Owners, Technical Lead, and QA Lead to align delivery with technical and quality objectives.
Consolidate delivery status and provide reporting to the Programme Lead and stakeholders.
Act as the point of contact for Team Leads / Scrum Masters, ensuring their escalations are addressed and teams remain unblocked.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives across teams, focusing on delivery efficiency and predictability.
Release Management – coordinate both internal and external activities to ensure all prerequisites are met in a timely manner, appropriate resources are in place, and all relevant communications are provided.

Skills & Experience

Essential:

10+ years of experience in software delivery, project management, or a related technical discipline.
Solid experience delivering software projects using Agile/Scrum methodologies in a professional services or product environment.
Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), DevOps principles, and modern engineering practices.
Proven ability to manage client relationships effectively and communicate clearly at various levels of seniority.
Experience using delivery and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
Ability to manage competing priorities, work under pressure, and drive delivery in ambiguous or fast-paced environments.

Desirable:

Experience working in a management consultancy or systems integrator environment.
Relevant certifications: PSM, PRINCE2, AgilePM, PMP, or equivalent.
Familiarity with cloud-native delivery in any of the following AWS, Azure or GCP and CI/CD pipelines.
Exposure to scaled delivery frameworks such as SAFe or LeSS.
Degree in technical discipline (Software engineering etc)

Why you will enjoy working at BearingPoint Ireland?

We work in an open and collaborative way, where new ideas are always welcome. BearingPoint is an environment where potential and high performance is recognised and rewarded.

What we offer:

You will receive a competitive salary where you are rewarded for both your individual performance and company performance. You will also receive a best-in-class benefits package including holidays, private health insurance, pension contributions, gym/club subscription, wellness programmes, mobile phone and much more. In addition, we offer:

Hybrid working –
where each team has autonomy to determine their in-person and remote working schedule.

Continuous learning –
we understand that it is imperative to invest in our people’s development and we provide external training at prestigious universities such as Oxford and Yale

Social events –
our people perform best when they have a good work life balance, monthly events for all to attend

Diversity
– we are committed to having a diverse workforce where each individual feels they belong and can thrive in a work environment with a strong sense of community

Mentoring & coaching –
every employee has a development manager to help them grow their career with feedback via continuous conversations

Giving Back –
you will have an opportunity to join our many giving back initiatives including our commitment to sustainability. Our Emissions Calculator gathers accurate emissions data and enables our clients to understand their footprint and track progress on emission reduction and pave the way for a better future.

Together, we are more than business.

To see more from our people with their experiences of BearingPoint please visit our careers website www.bearingpoint.com

About BearingPoint

BearingPoint is an independent management and technology consultancy with European roots and a global reach. The company operates in four units: Consulting, Solutions, Business Services, and Ventures. Consulting covers the advisory business; Solutions provides the tools for successful digital transformation, advanced analytics and regulatory requirements; Business Services provides managed services beyond SaaS; Ventures drives the financing and development of start-ups. BearingPoint’s clients include many of the world’s leading companies and organizations. The firm has a global consulting network with more than 10,000 people and supports clients in over 75 countries, engaging with them to achieve measurable and sustainable success.

BearingPoint is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.title: CloudOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About Planet

Planet is a global provider of integrated technology and payments solutions for retail and hospitality customers.

We create great experiences for the millions of people who use our payments, software, and tax-free solutions every minute of every day.

Planet empowers its customers to deliver great customer experiences by combining payments and software in ways that drive greater loyalty, increase revenue and save time.

Founded over 35 years ago and with our headquarters in London, today we have more than 2,500 employees located across six continents serving our customers in more than 120 markets.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Cloud Operations Engineer with deep expertise in Microsoft Azure networking to join our Cloud & Infrastructure Services team. The ideal candidate will operate, secure, troubleshoot, and continuously improve cloud and hybrid network services that support business-critical platforms.

This role combines strong cloud operations capability with advanced knowledge of network architecture and protocols. The successful candidate will take ownership of Azure connectivity and network security services, support hybrid connectivity with on-premises and other cloud environments, automate network deployment and configuration, and lead the diagnosis and resolution of complex connectivity and performance issues.

Previous experience working within regulated industries (e.g., payments, financial services, PCI-DSS, healthcare, or other compliance-driven environments) is highly desirable.

What You Will Do

Operate, maintain, and improve highly available Azure and hybrid cloud network services.
Design and support Azure hub-and-spoke and Virtual WAN architectures, virtual networks, subnets, peering, user-defined routes, NAT Gateway, Private Link, private endpoints, and service endpoints.
Manage network security controls including Network Security Groups, Azure Firewall, Web Application Firewall, DDoS Protection, network segmentation, and controlled ingress and egress.
Operate hybrid connectivity using ExpressRoute, site-to-site and point-to-site VPNs, BGP, and integration with on-premises routing and security platforms.
Support Azure DNS, Private DNS, DNS forwarding and resolution across hybrid environments, and application delivery through Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Front Door, and third-party appliances.
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, applying peer review, testing, and controlled deployment practices to network changes.
Monitor network health, flow, latency, availability, capacity, and security signals using Azure Monitor, Network Watcher, logs, and observability platforms.
Troubleshoot complex issues across DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing, TLS, connectivity, and application network paths.
Lead or support incident response, root cause analysis, problem management, maintenance, and service restoration for production infrastructure.
Collaborate with security, platform engineering, application, and enterprise network teams to deliver secure and reliable connectivity.
Maintain network documentation, diagrams, operational procedures, standards, and runbooks, and contribute to disaster recovery and capacity planning.

Who You Are

Extensive hands-on experience operating Microsoft Azure infrastructure, with advanced expertise in Azure networking.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4 addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, routing, BGP, VPNs, proxies, load balancing, TLS, and network security principles.
Deep experience with Azure Virtual Network, peering, routing, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Private Link, Private DNS, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Front Door, and Network Watcher.
Proven ability to troubleshoot end-to-end connectivity and performance across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments using packet captures, flow logs, route analysis, DNS tools, and platform telemetry.
Experience with enterprise firewalls, network virtual appliances, web application firewalls, and traffic management technologies.
Experience using Terraform for repeatable, controlled Infrastructure as Code deployments.
Experience operating production services, responding to incidents, managing changes, and completing root cause analysis.
Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
Clear communication skills and the ability to produce accurate technical documentation and explain complex network issues to technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

Experience with Fortinet, F5, or comparable enterprise firewall and application delivery platforms.
Experience with Azure Virtual WAN, Azure Route Server, multi-region connectivity, and multi-cloud networking.
Knowledge of Zero Trust networking, PCI-DSS controls, and network segmentation in regulated environments.
Experience with monitoring and observability platforms and analysis of network and security telemetry.

Preferred Experience

Experience working in regulated environments such as payments, financial services, banking, healthcare, or other compliance-driven industries.
Relevant certifications such as Azure Network Engineer Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or recognized enterprise networking certifications.

On-Call Requirements

This position supports business-critical production infrastructure and network services. Participation in an on-call rotation is expected, and candidates must be willing to provide out-of-hours support for connectivity incidents, security events, maintenance activities, and service restoration.

Why Planet

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce.

We would love to hear from you – Apply now
.

At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you want to build and modernize a market-leading SaaS platform that transforms complex transportation data into business value?

At IMI, we develop a market-leading SaaS platform that helps organizations control transportation costs, automate financial processes, and transform complex operational data into valuable business insights. Processing large volumes of business-critical data, our platform supports customers in improving efficiency, control, and decision-making.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team. You will work across the entire software development lifecycle and play a key role in the continued evolution of a business-critical SaaS platform.

Combining hands-on development with technical ownership, you will influence architecture, development practices, and technical decisions while helping deliver scalable, high-quality solutions.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will become an important part of a cross-functional team responsible for developing, maintaining, and modernizing business-critical software solutions. You will work across frontend, backend, databases, integrations, and cloud services while taking responsibility for delivering stable, scalable, and high-quality solutions.

The role involves close collaboration with product stakeholders, developers, customers, and domain experts. Beyond implementation, you will contribute to technical design, support the modernization of existing services, and take ownership of solutions throughout their entire lifecycle, from initial requirements to stable production use.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and enhance software solutions across frontend, backend, and databases
Translate product requirements into stable, scalable, and user-friendly solutions
Develop APIs and integrations with external systems
Contribute to the modernization of existing services and the reduction of technical debt
Work with data models, SQL, reporting, and analytical datasets
Ensure quality through testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, and production follow-up
Contribute to technical decisions, architecture, and development standards while taking ownership of deliveries from design through production

Your Profile

We believe you are an experienced software engineer with strong technical expertise and a product-oriented mindset. You enjoy solving complex challenges, modernizing existing solutions, and building scalable systems that create lasting business value.

You thrive in an environment that combines ownership, autonomy, and collaboration. Taking responsibility for technical decisions and architecture, you balance technical quality with business needs while contributing to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

We Believe You Have:

A degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
Solid and documented experience developing and maintaining production-critical software solutions
Experience developing transaction-intensive systems that process large volumes of business-critical data
Experience with C#, .NET, SQL, relational databases, and modern frontend development using JavaScript or TypeScript
Experience working with APIs, integrations, and cloud platforms such as Azure
Experience with automated testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, CI/CD, and modern software delivery practices
Experience taking responsibility for complete deliveries from requirements and technical design through deployment and production follow-up
Strong communication skills in both Norwegian and English

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience modernizing legacy or business-critical systems
Experience with Azure services, message-based or asynchronous architectures, and scalable cloud solutions
Experience with reporting, analytics, simulation, or data-intensive B2B products
Experience integrating with ERP systems or other external platforms
Experience with technical leadership, mentoring, or professional coaching
Experience with customer dialogue, requirements gathering, or logistics-related solutions

The position is primarily based in Fredrikstad. We work mainly from the office, with flexibility to work remotely when needed.

Why IMI?

IMI Supply Chain Solutions is a leading software provider specializing in sustainable logistics and order management. Our solutions are at the core of critical industries such as grocery retail and pharmaceutical supply chains. We are in an exciting phase of growth, offering you the opportunity to influence both our products and the way we work with product development going forward.

We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified and offer a workplace with a strong sense of team spirit, a high degree of autonomy, and excellent opportunities for professional development. In addition, we offer a competitive benefits package including extra vacation days and an attractive pension plan.

Application

Is this the right role for you? We warmly welcome your application. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. If you have any questions about the position, please contact our HR Business Partner, Ebba Olofsson, at ebba.olofsson@im.se.

jobs.title: Join BELLA Intelligence as a Software Developer
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
BELLA Intelligence is a niche software platform for insolvency case management, and part of Karnov Group. You don’t need to be a legal expert—or an Ace Attorney—to make an impact here. If you’re a Software Developer seeking a place with talented colleagues, meaningful technical challenges, and a supportive culture, this opportunity is for you. Keep reading to learn more about the role and why BELLA could be your next great move.

The Role

We’re looking for a developer with a user-centric mindset and a drive to evolve the product in step with the market, execute our roadmap, and meet client expectations. You’ll work with modern technologies and have a significant opportunity to grow, diversify your skill set, and contribute to an exciting growth journey.

You’ll work across the full stack and the end-to-end development lifecycle—UX/UI, coding, testing, debugging, and more. You’ll also contribute to broader business topics at BELLA, including the product roadmap, IT infrastructure, and domain-specific decisions. Collaboration is central: you’ll partner with the BELLA team to share progress and tackle challenges, and work with developers to refine requirements, design solutions, and deliver new features.

The Stack 

.NET
Front-end: React with TypeScript
Database: Microsoft SQL

Must Have

Minimum 3 years of experience working with .NET. (Preference for .NET Framework however .NET Core will also work)
Strong English skills in reading, writing and speaking
Strong communication skills
Business understanding, enabling you to consult and contribute to BELLA’s product roadmap, IT infrastructure, and other domain-specific topics.
A curiosity and eagerness to stay up to date with the latest software developments, trends, and technologies
Strong collaborative skills

Nice to Have 

Entity Framework
HTML
CSS
RxJS
Redux
Azure

About BELLA Intelligence

BELLA Intelligence, part of Karnov Group, is a cloud-based SaaS platform that streamlines daily workflows for managing insolvency cases. Our service includes secure hosting of case-related data.

We’re a small, flat, and highly transparent team with a strong professional culture. BELLA Intelligence is the market leader in its niche in Denmark, and we’re on a growth journey—focused on delivering business-critical functionality, reducing time to value, and accelerating our expansion into Sweden.

About Karnov 

Karnov Group is a leading provider of critical legal, tax, and compliance information across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, France, Spain, and Portugal. We’re in the midst of an exciting transformation — evolving from a traditional publisher into a modern technology company. 

Throughout the entire Karnov Group we work on a foundation of trust and transparency, and psychological safety is a key value in our culture. You’ll work alongside talented colleagues who support each other and share a drive to build the best tools possible for our customers. We’re located right by Nørreport Station in central Copenhagen. We offer great flexibility and expect you to take ownership and responsibility together with your team. We have a common-sense driven hybrid remote policy.

Apply

Interested? Reach out to Kenan Jugo, Commercial Director, Portfolio Companies, at kenan.jugo@karnovgroup.com . We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate. We look forward to hearing from you.
